name: Coolify
summary: Coolify, a self-hosted platform for deploying your own apps.
getting_started: Open http://your-server-address:8000 and sign in with the root email and password shown once. The login is also stored on the server in /root/.beltoft-app/credentials.json. The first sign-in is not encrypted. Add a domain with HTTPS for the dashboard in its settings, then use that address. Docker-published ports can be internet-reachable even when ufw is on; review exposed ports before deploying apps. Coolify updates are manual.
